title: SaaS Subscription Agreement
text:
SAAS SUBSCRIPTION AGREEMENT

This Agreement is between Cloudline Software Ltd (Provider) and Meridian Retail BV (Customer), effective 1 May 2025.

1. Subscription
Provider grants Customer a non-exclusive right to use the hosted inventory platform for 50 named users during the subscription term. Customer may not sublicense access.

2. Fees
Customer pays EUR 2,000 per month, invoiced monthly in advance and due within 30 days. Taxes are excluded.

3. Renewal
The initial term is 12 months and automatically renews for successive 12-month terms unless Customer gives written non-renewal notice at least 90 days before the term ends. Provider may decline renewal on 10 days' notice.

4. Price Changes
Provider may increase any fee at any time during the term without notice or Customer consent, and the increased fee applies to the next invoice.

5. Service Levels
Provider will make the platform available 99.9% of each calendar month, excluding scheduled maintenance announced 48 hours in advance. Customer receives a proportional service credit for missed availability.

6. Data and Security
Customer owns its uploaded data. Provider will encrypt data in transit and at rest and notify Customer of a confirmed personal-data breach within 72 hours. Provider will return Customer data within 30 days after termination.

7. Liability
Customer's liability for every claim is unlimited, including ordinary billing disputes. Provider's total liability for all claims is capped at one month's subscription fee, including Provider's gross negligence and data breaches.

8. Termination
Either party may terminate for a material breach that remains uncured 30 days after written notice. Fees for unused prepaid months will be refunded if Customer terminates for Provider's uncured breach.

9. Governing Law
The laws of the Netherlands govern this Agreement. Disputes are submitted to the courts of Amsterdam.
